title: Fix frontend admin password submissions to accept Liderdoprojetox1 after backend verification

requirements.summary: Ensure admin password submissions pass the gate and admin profile setup when the backend confirms "Liderdoprojetox1" is valid.
acceptanceCriteria: In the AdminPasswordGate screen, entering "Liderdoprojetox1" and submitting results in the success state (gate passed) rather than the "incorrect password" error.
In the ProfileSetupDialog admin role flow, entering "Liderdoprojetox1" allows completion of the flow without showing an "incorrect password" error.

file_operations.description: Harden the password submission flow so the exact user-entered password is sent to the backend consistently (e.g., trim accidental leading/trailing whitespace before calling useVerifyAdminPassword), and ensure the UI reliably transitions to the passed-gate success state (useAdminGate.passGate) when the backend returns true. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Normalize the admin password input prior to submission (e.g., trim whitespace) when calling useAddAllowlistedAdminPrincipal, and refine error handling so backend-confirmed success proceeds to saving the admin profile while only genuine authorization/password failures show the 'incorrect password' messaging. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Adjust the admin-related mutations’ error handling (useVerifyAdminPassword / useAddAllowlistedAdminPrincipal consumers) to consistently surface authorization/password failures versus transient/system errors (without hardcoding any password value), supporting the corrected leader password flow once the backend confirms validity. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
